manifest.title_fil: Suriin ang sitwasyon at humingi ng tulong
manifest.title_en: Assess the situation and get help
objectives_fil: Tukuyin ang panganib, magtalaga ng tatawag, ilarawan ang tugon at paghinga, at ibigay ang lokasyon.
objectives_en: Mark hazards, assign the call, state response and breathing observations, and give a concise location report.

sections.takeaway_fil: Kaso: May nadapang sakay sa tabi ng dumaraang sasakyan.
sections.takeaway_en: Case: A rider has fallen beside moving traffic.

sections.takeaway_fil: Tukuyin ang panganib, magtalaga ng tatawag, ilarawan ang tugon at paghinga, at ibigay ang lokasyon.
sections.takeaway_en: Mark hazards, assign the call, state response and breathing observations, and give a concise location report.

sections.takeaway_fil: Tingnan ang panganib bago lumapit; agad tatawag ang saksi.
sections.takeaway_en: Check hazards before approaching; the bystander calls at once.

check.prompt_fil: Dumating si Lea sa gilid ng kalsada kasama ang saksi. Ano ang uuna?
check.prompt_en: Lea reaches the roadside with a bystander. What comes first?

options.fil: Lumapit agad sa sakay para makita kung gaano kalala ang pinsala.
options.en: Walk straight to the rider to see how badly he is hurt.

options.fil: Tingnan ang trapiko, saka patawagin ang saksi.
options.en: Check the traffic, then have the bystander call.

options.fil: Itanong muna sa sakay at drayber ang nangyari bago tumawag.
options.en: Ask the rider and driver what happened before calling.

check.feedback_fil: 1: Gumagalaw pa ang trapiko. Malalagay rin sa panganib si Lea; tingnan muna ang panganib bago lumapit. 2: Tama. Inuuna ni Lea ang panganib, at agad tatawag ang saksi sa kumpirmadong emergency contact. 3: Naaantala ng mahabang history ang tawag. Iulat ang nakikita ngayon; makapaghihintay ang kuwento.
check.feedback_en: 1: Traffic is still moving. Stepping in first puts Lea at risk too; look for hazards before approaching. 2: Right. Lea looks for hazards first, and the bystander activates the confirmed emergency route without delay. 3: A full history delays the call. Report what you can see now; the story can wait.

sections.takeaway_fil: Tiningnan ni Lea ang trapiko, pinatawag ang saksi sa kumpirmadong contact, at iniulat ang nakita.
sections.takeaway_en: Lea checks traffic, has the bystander call the confirmed contact, and reports what she saw.

sections.takeaway_fil: Umiwas sa trapiko, tumawag agad, at gamitin ang lokal na kumpirmadong contact.
sections.takeaway_en: Stay out of traffic, call without delay, and use the locally verified contact.

sections.takeaway_fil: Iulat ang lokasyon at nakitang tugon at paghinga, hindi hula.
sections.takeaway_en: Report location and observed response and breathing, not guesses.

check.prompt_fil: Kausap na ng saksi ang kumpirmadong contact. Ano ang dapat sabihin ni Lea?
check.prompt_en: The bystander is on the phone with the confirmed contact. What should Lea tell them?

options.fil: Ang lokasyon at kung tumutugon at humihinga ang sakay.
options.en: The location and whether the rider responds and breathes.

options.fil: Ang hula niya sa pinsala ng sakay para alam nila ang dadalhin.
options.en: Her guess about the rider's injury, so they know what to bring.

options.fil: Na lumipat sa national number dahil puwede ang kahit anong numero.
options.en: To hang up and try the national number, since any number works.

check.feedback_fil: 1: Tama. Ang lokasyon at ang nakitang tugon at paghinga ang maikling ulat na kailangan ng sanay na tulong. 2: Iulat ang nakita, hindi ang hula. Ang sanay na tulong ang susuri. 3: Gamitin ang lokal na kumpirmadong contact. Huwag itong palitan ng national number.
check.feedback_en: 1: Right. Location plus the observed response and breathing is the concise report trained help needs. 2: Report observed facts, not guesses. Trained help does the assessment. 3: Use the locally verified contact. Do not assume a national number replaces it.

sections.takeaway_fil: Sanayin ang Lugar, Tawag at Ulat sa bagong kathang-isip na kaso.
sections.takeaway_en: Practise the scene, call and report steps with a new fictional case.
